remarks: At about 22:40 UTC, after this export, the four RAMSES matched runs of decay_supersonic at 256³ and 512³ were taken out of the sweep (`tools/sweep.py skip`; two were running, two queued). RAMSES matched stalls on this test: at 64³ and 128³ it reaches 10–20% of the run before the step cap, and the larger grids would have cost an estimated 20–50 thousand core-hours to record the same stall.
